# Agenda 0.3.0
This release establishes the shared update and support channel.
- Adds automatic local database snapshots on startup and every six hours. - Shows actionable diagnostics and a retry button if the embedded server cannot start. - Adds **Report a Problem** with version and recent server logs prefilled. - Adds **Check for Updates** and automatic updates powered by Sparkle.
Agenda 0.2.0 cannot update itself, so 0.3.0 is the final release that needs to be installed manually. Future releases can update in place.
